verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software through Fenwick Labs, including a custom trademark extranet, so the axis applies. The extranet offers searching, reporting and docket management across complete portfolios, with contents automatically synced to each docket. Separately, its due-diligence AI tool automates extracting key provisions across contracts. These show only portfolio-level reporting and automated processing, not user-driven bulk actions, and no API or llms.txt was found. Missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/update actions across many items, user-facing batch operations for AI-native workflows, API or programmatic bulk access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
